fields.additionalInformation:
Objective: check that interposer warpage at 245 C stays below 0.08 mm before the board attach build.
Reflow profile: peak 245 C, profile file attached (profile_245.pdf). Boards: synthetic test board TB-12, 1.6 mm FR-4.
Measurement area: full ball side, datum = best-fit plane of the corner balls.
Samples: as-molded interposers in dry-pack since molding; precondition per SYN-PR-201 before ball attach.
Report: coplanarity table per temperature, contour map at peak.

_why_good: Uses the same part identity on every table, so the lab can follow one part through the build.
States the stencil number and placement method.
Gives the capture temperatures and the decision the data supports.
